title: HELIOS GitHub label manifest (config/github/labels.json)
description: The shape scripts/github/apply-labels.ps1 reads: an object { $comment, labels: [...] } or a bare array of entries. An entry carries exactly name / color / description - the script marks any other key INVALID (exit 1) - so entries are closed here too. color is six hex digits (a leading '#' is tolerated and stripped by the script); description is capped at 100 characters by GitHub. Do not add a $schema key to the manifest: the bare-array form cannot carry one and the object form is wired to this schema through .vscode/settings.json json.schemas instead.

name.description: Label name; GitHub matches names case-insensitively and caps them at 50 characters. No leading or trailing whitespace.

color.description: Six hex digits; the script lowercases and strips a leading '#'.

description.description: At most 100 characters (GitHub's limit). Omit or leave empty to clear the live description.
